GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 388.3 (1 Nov 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 225)
APO 500
1 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Demobilization of Portion of Imperial Japanese Naval Personnel to Be Deferred.
1. Reference is made to your ND No. 199, subject as above, dated 22 October 1945.
2. The recommendation to defer demobilization of 5500 Naval Police, as set out in the referenced memorandum, is approved. These Naval Police will be demobilized as delivery of the Naval property which they are guarding is completed.
3. As demobilization is completed in each area, a report will be forwarded to this headquarters giving the date of completion.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
